caption: The video captures a hazy, low-contrast view dominated by a soft gray mist-like texture that fills the center and left portions of the view. Along the top edge hang pale, bare brownish branch silhouettes, while darker green leafy tree silhouettes run down the right side, and both sets of foliage remain essentially fixed in position. The broad gray field in the center and left slowly deforms and drifts from moment to moment, its light and dark patches shifting shape without any sharp object entering or leaving. In the lower-left, a darker diagonal region gradually changes its soft boundary and internal shading, consistent with the slow movement of the gray texture rather than a solid object translating. A small bright whitish speck sits near the center, holding roughly the same location with only negligible jitter. The upper branches and right-side trees stay aligned with the edges of the view, indicating that the viewpoint remains largely fixed. The drifting texture persists throughout the view, the soft shapes continuing to morph without settling into a fixed pattern.
